description: Run deterministic checks — a query plus the count it expects — against a document; one verdict per check: pass, fail, or inconclusive (a | group or | distinct hit its 100,000-value cap, so the count is only a lower bound; never reported as a pass). Pass playbookPath for a jsonloupe playbook file, or checks inline. Playbook functions are JavaScript and are never run here. Expectations: {"type":"no-matches"}, {"type":"at-least-one"}, {"type":"exact-count","count":N}, {"type":"at-most","count":N}, {"type":"at-least","count":N}, {"type":"between","min":M,"max":N}. A check counts matches (groups/distinct values for | group / | distinct); value pipes like | sum are refused. A document that is not valid JSON is refused unless allowRepair is true. Failed and inconclusive checks list their first matched paths. Pass filePath for a one-call answer, or docId to reuse an open document.

allowRepair.description: Check a document that is not valid JSON after repairing it (default false: refused, as a gate should not pass a broken file).

checks.description: Inline checks; use either this or playbookPath.

filePath.description: File to open and check now instead of supplying docId.

playbookPath.description: A jsonloupe playbook (.json) whose checks to run.

name: run_checks
